cash_flow_model.capital_and_remittance_evidence: Assume all cash is at the ordinary parent and distributable, with no restricted subsidiary cash, regulatory remittance cap or preference claim. Cash 25m and debt 50m are fictional starting balances; no scheduled debt maturity in the five-year model.

scenario_theses.Bear: Volume/revenue and all proportional operating and cash lines are 20% below Base; earnings payout percentage and share count unchanged.
scenario_theses.Base: Revenue 500m, profit 100m and OCF 130m in FY2026; unchanged real activity and nominal financial lines through FY2030.
scenario_theses.Bull: Volume/revenue and proportional operating and cash lines are 20% above Base; no multiple expansion or higher payout ratio.

business_outlook.fcf_change_decomposition: Revenue, earnings and all cash bridge lines use one explicit scenario factor: Bear 0.8, Base 1.0, Bull 1.2; hold that factor constant through all five years; no growth credit.
business_outlook.per_share_cash_outlook: No shares are issued or repurchased; 10m dividend-entitled shares each year. Payout is 40% of attributable earnings, not 40% of FAD.
business_outlook.liquidity_and_self_funding: Base year 1 distribution capacity 70m exceeds dividend entitlement/cash cost 40m by 30m; every scenario scales both cash and payout equally, so no modeled funding gap.

milestones.event: Renew service contracts and deliver the funded capacity plan
milestones.observable_threshold: Volume and OCF conversion no more than 10% below scenario plan; capacity delay no longer than one year.
milestones.source_to_revisit: A real application must obtain the next annual report and contract/capex update; this company is fictional.
milestones.fcf_implication: A lasting miss changes recurring FAD and funded DPS; a one-year timing miss changes dated growth PV only if later capacity is unchanged.
milestones.action_if_missed: Rebuild assumptions before any purchase decision.

payout_policy.basis_definition: 40% of ordinary-parent attributable earnings in the same fiscal year; no special dividends.
payout_policy.source_and_date: Fictional board policy assumption A3 dated 2026-01-01.
payout_policy.funding_constraint: Dividend entitlement and actual cash cost must each fit distribution capacity. Year 1 Base: 100m profit x 40% = 40m dividend versus 70m capacity.

return_requirements.benchmark_source: Teaching assumption A5 dated 2026-01-01; 4% is not a fetched Treasury quote.
return_requirements.tax_and_fx_basis: USD reporting, USD quote and USD shareholder cash; FX 1. Assume zero shareholder withholding, fees and personal tax for this fictional case only. Real tax/custody status must be verified independently; this is not an HK resident tax conclusion.
price_independent_risk_factors: 4 percentage points lower premium for renewal/operating risk; 6 points upper premium adds cash conversion and concentration stress. Neither depends on price or score.
return_requirements.limitations: The 8%-10% nominal total-return range is a teaching input. The ordinary income thresholds give no growth credit and do not establish full business intrinsic value.

checks.evidence: Forward net cash 4 equals N=4.
B/price=3.2/40=8%, below r_high=10%.
N/price=10% exceeds independently stipulated R_low=8%.

modules.cap_reason: Medium confidence and Acceptable safety; no fallback or lower cap.

modules.rationale: The teaching case stipulates stable ordinary DPS of 4 and no cut.

checks.evidence: All five annual ordinary payments occurred on schedule in the stipulated history.
No inflation series establishes real DPS stability.
A full adverse-cycle dividend record is not supplied.

missing_evidence: Inflation and a full adverse-cycle history for refinement, not for the established no-cut band.

modules.rationale: (70+80+90)/(40+40+40)=2.0x recurring coverage; actual shortfalls remain visible.

checks.evidence: Each first-three-year scenario funds the full entitlement from recurring FAD and actual capacity.
Worst actual cash coverage was 35/40=0.875x.
Cash availability is stipulated; a separately disclosed stress-liquidity buffer analysis is not supplied.

modules.cap_reason: No unresolved recurring shortfall in the stipulated model; the actual shortfall is separately disclosed.
missing_evidence: Independent stress-liquidity corroboration beyond the bounded teaching assumptions.

modules.rationale: Cash 25m, debt 50m, EBITDA 100m and no five-year refinancing need support manageable leverage.

checks.evidence: No maturities fall within 24 months; modeled cash covers committed uses.
No additional contractual covenant thresholds are supplied for the refinement test.
The five-year investment plan is internally funded without uncommitted external capital.

missing_evidence: Detailed covenant corroboration beyond the stipulated unrestricted capital access.

modules.rationale: A funded 40%-of-profit policy is reasonable but remains discretionary.

checks.evidence: Each modeled entitlement applies 40% to attributable profit, not FAD.
Maintenance, growth and mandatory uses are funded once before distribution.
No acquisition or issuance decision history is supplied.

modules.rationale: No buyback program; stable ownership is neutral discipline, not automatic top points.

checks.evidence: No issuance, scrip or repurchases; ten million entitled shares remain outstanding.
No contemporaneous valuation-based abstention decision is supplied.
No repurchase-program stress-capital assessment is supplied.

modules.cap_reason: No program does not redistribute the weight or justify maximum points.
missing_evidence: Repurchase/abstention valuation and program-specific stress evidence.

modules.rationale: Bounded operating, capital and payout estimates reconcile; execution is not independently corroborated.

checks.evidence: Years 1-3 reconcile operating cash, FAD, policy and entitled shares.
Years 4-5 use the same funded assumptions and explicit annual bridges.
No prior milestone-delivery record is supplied.

modules.cap_reason: No illustrative-DPS or Structural Decline cap; confidence remains Medium.

scorecard.grade_cap_reason: No Structural Decline; final Grade follows the sum.

dividend_quality.label: Medium
dividend_quality.rule: Quality 51-67 out of 85 is Medium; current price is excluded.
dividend_quality.upgrade_trigger: Additional supported quality refinements raise quality to at least 68, without changing price.

dividend_safety.label: Acceptable
dividend_safety.rule: Aggregate >=1.0x and a funded Base policy with bounded stress; 2x alone is not Strong.
dividend_safety.supporting_evidence: Recurring coverage is 2x; actual 0.875x in FY2025 required 5m of the assumed cash buffer.
dividend_safety.upgrade_trigger: Corroborated stress liquidity and sustained actual coverage without exceptional buffer draws.
dividend_safety.downgrade_trigger: Recurring cash no longer funds policy and no credible adjustment/funding path exists.

withholding_efficiency.label: High
withholding_efficiency.rule: Supported withholding <=10% is High, separate from company safety.
withholding_efficiency.supporting_evidence: The fictional applicable company announcement stipulates zero withholding and fees.
withholding_efficiency.upgrade_trigger: Already in the highest band; retain only with applicable event/channel evidence.
withholding_efficiency.downgrade_trigger: Applicable withholding exceeds 10% or the treatment becomes unverified.

buyback_quality.label: Not Applicable
buyback_quality.rule: No program keeps the label Not Applicable; per-share discipline still receives its fixed-weight score.
buyback_quality.supporting_evidence: Stable ten million shares and no program support neutral band 2, five points.
buyback_quality.upgrade_trigger: A funded program or documented value-based abstention establishes stronger per-share discipline.
buyback_quality.downgrade_trigger: Issuance or debt-funded repurchases impair continuing owners.

three_year_outlook.label: Stable
three_year_outlook.rule: Funded Base year-3 net DPS is within 5% of year 1.
three_year_outlook.supporting_evidence: Base net DPS remains 4; Bear remains 3.2 under the explicit flat-capacity case.
three_year_outlook.upgrade_trigger: A funded operating path supports more than 5% three-year per-share dividend growth.
three_year_outlook.downgrade_trigger: A policy/cash reset implies more than 5% decline or an unbounded path.

fundamental_trend.label: Stable
fundamental_trend.rule: Normalized operating capacity is maintained; price performance does not select the trend.
fundamental_trend.supporting_evidence: Maintenance and required growth uses preserve flat per-share capacity through year 5.
fundamental_trend.upgrade_trigger: Incremental funded demand and investment establish structural per-share growth.
fundamental_trend.downgrade_trigger: Persistent demand or margin erosion changes normalized capacity.

forecast_confidence.label: Medium
forecast_confidence.rule: Bounded, reconciled analyst estimates can be Medium without perfect forward knowledge.
forecast_confidence.supporting_evidence: All five cash/policy/share scenarios reconcile, but delivery assumptions lack independent corroboration.
forecast_confidence.upgrade_trigger: Contracted/observed operating outcomes and capital evidence corroborate the forecasts.
forecast_confidence.downgrade_trigger: A material operating, investment, policy or share-count assumption becomes unbounded.

portfolio_role.label: Watchlist
portfolio_role.rule: Security-level durable ordinary cash and Acceptable safety, not a score-to-role mapping.
portfolio_role.supporting_evidence: The stipulated recurring business and funded ordinary policy support an income role; no personal allocation is inferred.
portfolio_role.upgrade_trigger: Already a core-income candidate under the assumptions; actual portfolio fit needs the user's mandate.
portfolio_role.downgrade_trigger: Cash becomes cycle-dependent, safety weakens, or a material entry/mandate gate fails.

entry_plan.summary: At the fictional price 40, gradual accumulation is supported; Medium confidence and Acceptable safety prevent Strong Buy.
entry_plan.opportunity_thesis: A funded ordinary dividend of 4 gives a 10% normalized yield versus an independently assumed 8%-10% requirement; waiting for every refinement would forgo supported cash income.
entry_plan.market_expectation_gap: Price 40 implies a 10% normalized yield. No consensus dataset is supplied, so this is a reverse-price comparison, not a claim that the market is wrong.

stages.condition: N/r_low; maintain the funded Base cash path and passing capital-return review. No investor hard-income floor was supplied.
N/r_high; current price meets this threshold, but Medium confidence still limits the action to gradual accumulation.
B/r_high plus High confidence and Strong safety. Both the price and the stronger evidence conditions would be needed.

return_scenarios.basis: Three entitled full-year Bear payments; exit at year-3 Bear DPS /10%. USD, zero tax/fees and no reinvestment are explicit assumptions.
Three entitled full-year Base payments; exit at year-3 Base DPS /8%. Exit-yield compression is a scenario assumption, not guaranteed mean reversion.
Three entitled full-year Bull payments; exit at year-3 Bull DPS /8%. Costs are stipulated zero, not omitted real broker costs.

risk_review.rationale: Under this teaching case the Bear exit loses 20% of principal while three years of cash make cumulative return +4%; Base is +55%, partly dependent on an 8% exit yield. This research assumption accepts the modeled capital path, not an inferred personal loss tolerance. A worse/unfunded Bear case would invalidate it.

blockers.reason: Medium confidence and Acceptable safety cap the action below Strong Buy, not below accumulation.
blockers.resolution: Corroborate contracted delivery, stress liquidity and actual coverage before a stronger rating.

blockers.reason: No personal holdings or concentration budget supplied.
blockers.resolution: Obtain portfolio and mandate inputs before sizing; do not block security-level entry analysis.

catalysts.event: Next ordinary results and dividend declaration
catalysts.check_date_or_period: FY2026 results; announcement date not supplied
catalysts.confirmation: Recurring FAD and unrestricted parent cash continue to fund the 40%-of-profit entitlement.
catalysts.source_to_revisit: Issuer cash-flow, capital and dividend-policy disclosures
catalysts.if_missed: Pause additions and rebuild the operating/cash/policy bridge.

invalidation_conditions: Recurring FAD or available parent cash fails to fund the policy without a credible adjustment.
A persistent operating decline, material issuance or payout restriction requires re-estimating N/B and all stage prices.

report_output.title: 虚构公司股息研究示例
report_output.summary: 仅用于验证规则，不构成真实投资意见。

sections.heading: 结论速览
paragraphs: 本例为虚构经营公司；现金派息能力由经营现金扣除维护投资、成长投入和强制用途后推导，不使用一次性资本回收支持普通股息。预测可信度中等，不能触发强力买入。

sections.heading: 财务状况
paragraphs: 基准年度经常性所有者现金为一亿元，扣除两千万元成长投入及五百万元强制用途，可持续可分配现金为七千五百万元；再扣除五百万元实际特殊现金支出。权益股息四千万元有现金覆盖，所有数字均为教学假设。

sections.heading: 买点观点
paragraphs: 下列三档只代表对应现金与估值门槛；必须同时核对风险、资本及税务条件，不可把已到参考价格等同于所有档位均可执行。

sections.heading: 长期展望：业务与股息
paragraphs: 前三年逐年验证业务、现金、政策和股数桥；第四、五年延伸依赖明确经营假设。压力情景退出价格可能损害本金，即使收到股息也不保证总回报。

sections.heading: 风险点与跟踪信号
paragraphs: 重点跟踪经营现金低于假设、成长投资超支、派息政策改变及股数摊薄。任一变化必须重新核对每股可分配能力，不能用估值便宜掩盖质量恶化。

sections.heading: 数据来源与关键假设
paragraphs: 全部资料来自虚构教学案例；本例只验证算术、字段与决策一致性，不声称查询真实公司。未提供的购买力与细化证据依照下面取数日志处理。
